description: Delivered 3 December 1970; registered 14 December 1970 as CCCP-87780 to the Uzbek Civil Aviation Directorate at Tashkent-Yuzhny; struck off 19 November 1987; obtained through the Uzstalkonstruktsiya trust and moved by road over three days in 1987 to the Mekhnat recreation base at the Chimgan ski resort about 80 km north of Tashkent; used as a cafe and video hall; by summer 2020 the undercarriage legs and tail surfaces had been cut off and sold for scrap so the airframe is now incomplete; year_built from the delivery date
